title: Stir-Fried Turkey with Peppery Flair
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with juicy turkey, crunchy veggies, and a hint of peppery spice.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the turkey breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
3. Remove the turkey from the skillet and set aside.
4. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
5. Add the sliced peppers and onions to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
6. Add the bamboo shoots to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the stir-fry sauce and soy sauce.
8. Pour the sauce into the skillet and stir to combine.
9. Add the cooked turkey back into the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
10. Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
